id_formula: ctype-uca1400.h: charset encoding=(id>>8)&7; 0=mb3,1=mb4,2=ucs2,3=utf16,4=utf32; tailoring and PAD/strength bits zero for these ids
important: measured handler spans enclose full my_uca_coll_init_utf8mb3/4 wrappers; do not attribute whole span to booster allocation without separate evidence

candidate.hypothesis: Repeated construction of optional UCA UTF8 comparison booster tables is a useful bounded candidate; full handler spans are measured, booster-exclusive time is not
candidate.safe_trial_boundary: Do not set booster=NULL while keeping readers unchanged. ctype-uca.inl has compile-time MY_UCA_ASCII_OPTIMIZE paths that dereference it unconditionally. A prototype must disable construction and every corresponding comparison/hash fast path together, or preserve valid tables.
candidate.semantic_risk: Keep UCA1400 collation selection/weights/support; test ordering, equality, UNIQUE, ORDER BY, mixed ASCII/non-ASCII/contractions/PAD and hashing against native; slower SQL is a tradeoff to measure
candidate.alternatives: Precompute reusable deterministic booster data after identity/pointer/ownership analysis; larger scope than first disabled-fastpath diagnostic
